target: Locate a failure and test a causal remedy for symbolic reasoning using a rule-based inference trace. Use a small, fully specified worked case and then change one input.

competency.title: Diagnose symbolic reasoning — worked example
competency.outcome: Locate a failure and test a causal remedy for symbolic reasoning using a rule-based inference trace. Use a small, fully specified worked case and then change one input.
competency.practice_task: Produce a fault trace, hypothesis table and controlled repair grounded in a rule-based inference trace.
competency.setting_constraint: Use a small, fully specified worked case and then change one input.
required_evidence: a fault trace, hypothesis table and controlled repair
Include the solved case and the changed-case prediction.
Report valid conclusions and contradiction rate with uncertainty or an explicit deterministic check.
Construct a negative control for the failure mode: skipping an unstated premise.

assessment.scoring: Each criterion: 0 absent, 1 partial, 2 demonstrated; require 2 on all four.
assessment.threshold_policy: Register the metric threshold, baseline, task budget and evaluator before exposing new items.
criteria: Concept: correctly state the assumptions and limits of symbolic reasoning.
Practice: the repair fixes the target without hiding a regression.
Measurement: report valid conclusions and contradiction rate against a matched baseline with reproducible inputs.
Critical check: test for skipping an unstated premise; detect it or rule it out with evidence.

competency.source_policy: Reviewer must add a verified primary source before lesson status; no source is fabricated here.
competency.contamination_policy: No private items, answers, seeds or reviewer-only prompts in this public specification.
